fusions.name: Late Unsheathing
fusions.desc: Springs you onto a target up to 6 tiles away, dealing 12 damage and leaving it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Play's Over
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health. A lunge at a target up to 4 tiles away that deals 22 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at full reach.

fusions.name: Claws Kept In
fusions.desc: Veils you for 10 seconds: enemies notice you 60% later, you move 10% faster, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Righted in the Fall
fusions.desc: Every time you avoid a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 6. The next ability you use spends them all: you deal 3% more damage per stack (18% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
